CommunityApplications.Profile:
Bulk Share Toggle adds a Shares -> Bulk Share Toggle page to Unraid where you can tick multiple user shares and apply an SMB export change (Share / Share Hidden / Unshare) to all of them at once, instead of editing each share's Settings tab individually. This repository contains the single Bulk Share Toggle plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-bulk-share-toggle/issues
